# Loyaltie Connect

> Add day-to-day shopping to your agent or app: open catalog of independent brands, agent skill and cart links. No sign-up or key. Builders can earn 5 to 10% of the whole basket.

- [skill.md](https://github.com/loyaltie-partners/connect/blob/main/skill.md): set up any agent to shop Loyaltie
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/loyaltie-partners/connect/blob/main/README.md)
- [Catalog fields](https://github.com/loyaltie-partners/connect/blob/main/docs/catalog.md)
- [Cart links](https://github.com/loyaltie-partners/connect/blob/main/docs/cart-links.md)
- [Earn](https://github.com/loyaltie-partners/connect/blob/main/docs/earn.md)
- [FAQ](https://github.com/loyaltie-partners/connect/blob/main/docs/faq.md)
- [Start building](https://loyaltie.com/sell/connect-start-building)
